title: The question-form check refuses a page question whose only change is a widening form
why: Incident, 2026-11-07 15:38 CST: triage put item 376 on the page. Its only change from main was a widening option, and decision uniform-over-variants already rules that the shared tool never grows a second form. The coordinator withdrew it at 15:41 CST. The owner saw a question a ruling answers.
note: In hooks/question_form.py: when every option but the recommended one sets widens:true, refuse with 'uniform-over-variants decides this; take the non-widening option'. Done check: item 376's shape is red, and a question with two non-widening options passes. The check's verdict changes, so this is a build lane. Lane past-ruling-on-send takes it on a new branch (coordinator, 15:44 CST). In review round 1 at 17:05 CST. Back to ready 07:22 CST Nov 12 (coordinator yes 07:21 CST): no live lane (was [ended:lane:-past-ruling-on-send]). Coordinator 13:37 CST Nov 12: already pushed 1416409b9, so it finishes; no fold. Owner page save 15:22 CST Nov 12: item 643 none of these, "why the fuck would we have a guard just for one kind of question? or am i misunderstanding something"; reworded 15:25 CST (the check is general; 643 is its corner case) and reopened; #2929 waits.
